source.filename: ฝึก-AI-ประตูน้ำก่อนตลาดท่วม-1.mp4

review.method: sampled actual MP4 frames at 0.75-second intervals plus higher-resolution scene frames and numerical audio RMS; compared with supplied source JSON
review.notes: Audio waveform analysis cannot verify exact words, pronunciation or emotional acting. Static frame samples cannot prove all rig motions or all frame-level defects.

audio.notes: Close to one second of digital silence at each scene boundary. No audible continuous ambiance can be inferred during these digital-zero intervals.

issues.observed: Wide storm/market and a grille-like gate in foreground; narration says sea level rises, but the water-rise event is not clearly discernible over these sampled frames.
issues.required: Introduce a legible waterline or gauge and animated water rising while market lights and vendors are established; avoid unrelated dark polygon in sky.
issues.accept: A viewer can point to water rising between two timestamps without relying on the caption.

issues.observed: Floodgate resembles an ordinary barred doorway/shutter; rust, gate mechanism, pressure side and discharge point are unclear. Leak is small/ambiguous relative to narration.
issues.required: Design recognizable concrete channel, gate leaf, hoist gear, upstream/downstream water levels, rust, clear lower-edge jet and splashes; use detail shot/push-in on leak.
issues.accept: Without reading subtitles, viewers recognize a leaking sluice gate rather than a building doorway.

issues.observed: Pim runs/poses by essentially the same gate and market background. No shopkeepers, warning response or boxes being moved appear in sampled frames.
issues.required: Add distinct shopkeeper figures; visible warning gesture, reaction, and lifting crates to upper ground; route Pim along the quayside with a meaningful camera pan and verified feet/arm motion.
issues.accept: The warning and response are understandable without narration; feet stay grounded and no joints penetrate the body.

issues.observed: Water grows as a large translucent blue overlay across foreground/buildings; the market appears unattended earlier too, so evacuation and survival on high ground are never shown.
issues.required: Animate floodwater within street/pier geometry, with shoreline/ripples and correct occlusion. Establish market populated earlier, then remove people after evacuation; add hill/people safe as a concluding shot.
issues.accept: Water is constrained to the lowland and scene visually shows 'empty because evacuated' plus safe people on higher ground.

issues.observed: Four sections repeatedly use a similar gate-and-market medium framing; the giant dark planar/polygonal shape in the night sky is visually distracting and unmotivated.
issues.required: Shot sequence: establishing harbor/sea → close gate leak → tracking Pim toward merchant → flood impact → cut to hill. Remove or identify unexplained dark overlay; check camera coordinate/world cropping.
issues.accept: Each shot reveals its narrated object; panorama is perceptible and visual artefacts do not obscure narrative elements.

issues.observed: Four near-continuous voiced segments separated by ~1.05 s of digital silence; audio is dual-mono, and rain is visually present throughout.
issues.required: Remove rigid one-second dead air at cuts or use intentional crossfade, and add gently mixed weather/market/sluice sounds under narrator (without masking words). Match soundscape to actual weather.
issues.accept: No unexplained silent gaps >0.5s at scene cuts in a rainstorm; voice remains clear, ambience survives the cut.

issues.observed: Export subtitles remain centered inside frame and no right-edge clipping found in sampled frames; several clauses are broken mid-phrase (e.g. 'พิมมองเห็นบานเหล็ก / ของ...').
issues.required: Use natural Thai phrase segmentation and timed speech-derived cues. Keep portrait safe region and avoid single-word orphan lines.
issues.accept: At most two readable lines with no orphan phrase or off-frame text and start/end near speech; manually confirm against the heard narration.

positives: Export aspect 512×910 stays close to 9:16; no observed clipped subtitle at frame edge in sampled frames.
The app shortened original nominal 35 s timeline to ~20.24 s rather than padding silence to target 60 s.
Sea-storm mood, market silhouettes, foreground floodgate and a cartoon actor are now present; foundations exist but are not yet narratively clear.
recommendedTrainingOrder: implement fixes to source SVG/worldEffects and storyboard
pair before/after segments with approved scene-action QA labels
train small CPU scene-selection/motion-ranking models on many stories; do not train on this single clip or put it into Layout approved dataset
